description: TRY_TO_DECIMAL and TRY_TO_NUMERIC are Snowflake synonyms of TRY_TO_NUMBER, mirroring TO_DECIMAL / TO_NUMERIC for TO_NUMBER. Neither synonym was registered, so a loader using TRY_TO_DECIMAL failed with Unknown function. They parse a numeric string, answer NULL on garbage, and share the TRY_CAST source rule: an UNTYPED NULL errors while NULL::VARCHAR converts to NULL. Converted 1:1 from functions/TryToDecimalTest (now retired); the Java compared two separate query results to show the synonym, which the converted test does inside one statement.
